BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to boundary review board disbandings; amending RCW36.93.230; creating a new section; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 36.93.230 and 1991 sp.s. c 32 s 22 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) When a county and the cities and towns within the county haveadopted a comprehensive plan and consistent development regulations((pursuant to the provisions of)) under chapter 36.70A RCW, the countymay((, at the discretion of the county legislative authority,)) submita ballot measure to the voters of the county proposing the disbandingof the boundary review board. If twothirds of the voters voting onthe measure approve the disbanding, the county legislative authoritymay disband the boundary review board in that county. (2) The termination date of a boundary review board disbanded undersubsection (1) of this section is December 31st of the year in whichthe ballot measure is approved, or six months after the election inwhich the ballot measure is approved, whichever is later. (3) A boundary review board subject to disbandment under subsection(1) of this section: p. 1 HB 3260 (a) Must complete all pending actions before the board prior todisbanding; and (b) May not accept additional requests for new reviews of proposedactions after the county legislative authority authorizes thedisbanding.
This act applies to any boundary reviewboard in existence on or after January 1, 2006.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
